extracted.name: Chicken & beetroot lentil salad
extracted.description: Make two meals in one: rustle up our creamy garlic chicken and polenta dinner then reinvent the leftovers to make this vibrant beetroot salad with lentils
ingredient_lines: ½ small savoy cabbage finely sliced
2 leftover chicken legs skin removed and meat shredded
small handful mixture of soft herbs (we used parsley and dill)
instruction_lines: In a large bowl, combine the honey, mustard, vinegar and oil. Season, then mix in the lentils, cabbage, chicken and herbs. Divide between bowls, then scatter over the goat’s cheese, beetroot and pomegranate.
